Source-only correction c13b4fe0 completed and pushed on existing codex/smart-preview-ui775f39b0. Tests ea40431c/782752f3; product3029127b; handoff775f39b0; durable wp/B5-16 a1e07663. Prior refresh/badges/offline controls intact; no Document/SaveAs/binding edits.

Confirmed ef307d8d bug fixed at source: EngineLibrary.scan retains canonical index handle.path as folder, preserving friendly caller title. AppModel no longer remembers request URL before scan; only successful current-generation opens persist authoritative library.folder. Last/recent replace caller alias and canonical duplicate using lexical comparison, retain unrelated missing recents, no disconnected resolution. Full reopen/rescan and cached transition use same persistence adapter. If a rescan's ONLINE index path differs from current library identity, reopen a new library/session against returned canonical path rather than relabeling old CullSession; exceptional branch performs fresh online scan. Offline branch still no original index/list/recreation/canonicalization.

Added real online EngineLibrary empty-folder symlink scan -> actual AppModel history adapter with isolated defaults -> remove alias/move original -> real absence detection -> injected cached closure requires captured canonical path once and no original closure. Also requires friendly title, last/recent canonical persistence, alias dedupe and unrelated missing recent retained. All27 SmartPreview/offline tests UNRUN on B (20+7); source/diff-check only. Test does not prove real native proxy membership or GUI relaunch. A must compile/test including actual Sony alias-disconnect, native factory/binding integration and relaunch/reconnect/rescan GUI. Preexisting already-disconnected alias-only history cannot be inferred safely: reconnect/open once to establish index authority. Native contract unchanged. Source hold/paused heartbeat/existing writer preserved; A main ownership. This is source handoff, not runtime acceptance.
